title: Minimum Speed to Arrive on Time
goal: Find the smallest integer train speed that meets a time budget with whole-hour departures.
strategy: Every nonfinal ride rounds up to a whole hour. Feasibility improves with speed, so binary search using exact hundredth-hour comparisons.
